title: Nimbus returns the worker placement of every topology running on a supervisor, including the host, port, owner and…
description: A vulnerability in Nimbus allows an authenticated user with access to Nimbus to retrieve worker placement details of all topologies running on a supervisor, including sensitive information such as host, port, owner, and resource assignments, even for topologies they are not authorized to view. This issue affects multi-tenant clusters where users can learn about other users' topology deployments. The issue is fixed in version 3.2.0.
